description:
Aidie is KN Group's mascot robot that has been greeting the employees every morning. Its creator, Professor Harvey, takes Aidie on the day of his resignation and risks his life to protect it from the company. What secrets does this one robot hold?

[Pre-serialization](https://comic.naver.com/bestChallenge/list?titleId=392973)

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=3881724), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/51867896), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/3498000980), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/dpdlel), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/comic/jt_sr_0080), [Onestory](https://onestory.co.kr/detail/H037295110), [Nate](https://toonnbook.nate.com/detail/H037295110), [Anytoon](https://www.anytoon.co.kr/webtoon/episode/5598)

**Official Translations:**  
[English](https://www.webtoons.com/en/sf/aidie/list?title_no=9869), [Japanese](https://www.cmoa.jp/title/297466/) 

*Based on the 2012 OEL webcomic AIDIE, published on [Comic Panda/Tapastic](https://tapas.io/series/aidie/info) by Korean author JEON Sangjin.*
